description: EXAMPLE project labels for slurm_week.py (weekly-recap). Copy this file outside the skill folder (for example to ~/.config/workhub-claude/weekly-recap_project_rules.json), replace the rules with your own, and put its path in the settings file under skill_settings.weekly-recap.project_rules_file. Without that setting no rules are used: jobs linked to a Work Hub row are grouped by the row's Project, and jobs with no row get the label 'other: <job-name prefix>'. How the rules work: each job's name and working folder are joined, lower-cased and searched for each rule's patterns (plain substrings, not regular expressions). The FIRST rule with a matching pattern gives the label, so put specific rules before general ones. Use labels that match your Work Hub Project options where one fits.
